viral_ticker_tweets.title_zh: 为了使 AGI 造福全人类，它应该帮助人们完成对他们来说最重要的日常任务。因此，我们建立了 LifeVal，这是一个新的基准，根据数千名 ChatGPT 用户的反馈形成，这些用户最需要私人助理帮助的领域是从寻找托儿服务到获得政府服务再到管理
viral_ticker_tweets.full_text_en:
For AGI to benefit all of humanity, it should help people with the everyday tasks that matter most to them. So we built LifeVal, a new benchmark shaped by feedback from thousands of ChatGPT users on where they most want help from a personal assistant—from finding childcare to accessing government services to managing personal finances.

Over the past year, we’ve used LifeVal to measure and improve how well our models handle these everyday tasks.

https://t.co/GlUjixzEM0
viral_ticker_tweets.full_text_zh:
为了使 AGI 造福全人类，它应该帮助人们完成对他们来说最重要的日常任务。因此，我们建立了 LifeVal，这是一个新的基准，根据数千名 ChatGPT 用户的反馈形成，这些用户最需要私人助理帮助的领域是从寻找托儿服务到获得政府服务再到管理个人财务。

在过去的一年里，我们使用 LifeVal 来衡量和改进我们的模型处理这些日常任务的能力。

top_three.title_en: The New York Times sues Brave web browser for AI scraping and bypassing paywalls
top_three.author: The Verge AI
top_three.content_snippet:
The New York Times and a group of other publications have filed lawsuits against the company that makes the Brave web browser over alleged unlawful scraping to train AI and also letting users bypass their paywalls, as reported by Reuters.

According to a complaint filed by the companies that run New York Daily News, the Chicago Tribune, and the Orlando Sentinel, Brave Software has monetized its index of scraped websites by, in part, providing AI companies with paid access to  "real-time online c
top_three.summary_en: Major media outlets, including The New York Times and The Chicago Tribune, have filed a lawsuit against Brave browser. The plaintiffs allege that Brave is illegally scraping content for its 'Brave Index' to sell to AI companies for model training and providing tools for users to bypass paywalls, violating copyright and business rights.
top_three.summary_zh: 纽约时报》等机构起诉Brave浏览器，指控其未经授权抓取数据用于AI训练并帮助用户绕过付费墙
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】纽约时报、芝加哥论坛报等媒体集团在美国法院：对Brave浏览器提起诉讼，指控其未经授权抓取内容用于AI训练并绕过付费墙
【起因与机理】维护新闻内容商业版权，遏制AI公司未经授权的数据采集行为
【关键技术规格】多家知名媒体联手对峙Brave。
【观点态度】涉及AI训练数据合规性这一核心行业痛点。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] The New York Times, Chicago Tribune, and other publishers (US Courts): Sued Brave for unauthorized data scraping for AI training and paywall circumvention
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To protect commercial copyright and curb unauthorized AI data harvesting
[Key Specification] Major media publishers vs. Brave.
[Perspective & Impact] High-stakes battle over AI training data compliance.

top_three.title: OpenAI prepares lobbying blitz for a post-midterm Washington
top_three.title_en: OpenAI prepares lobbying blitz for a post-midterm Washington
top_three.author: THE DECODER
top_three.content_snippet:
OpenAI is gearing up for a political lobbying and PR push after the US midterms. According to Axios, the company is bracing for a tougher fight in Washington if Democrats win control of the House.

After two years under a friendly administration, big tech companies with close ties to President Trump are facing growing regulatory pressure. Rivals like Meta are already building bridges to Democrats. OpenAI's policy chief Chris Lehane plans to steer the AI debate through 2028 with a mix of new and
top_three.summary_en: OpenAI is ramping up lobbying efforts to navigate shifting political tides in Washington, promoting a narrative that AI won't replace humans while proposing 'speed limit' safety rules. The company is also rebranding energy-intensive data centers as 'AI Compute Campuses' to win public and regulatory support.

news.title: John Ternus says Apple expects memory costs to increase into December and beyond; Apple's inventory grew to $14.54B in Q4, up 31.1% QoQ and 154.3% YoY (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
news.title_en: John Ternus says Apple expects memory costs to increase into December and beyond; Apple's inventory grew to $14.54B in Q4, up 31.1% QoQ and 154.3% YoY (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
news.author: TechCrunch
news.content_snippet:
Apple’s stockpiling of inventory, particularly computer memory, continued in its fiscal fourth quarter, according to earnings reported Monday. The company reported that its inventory increased significantly in the quarter, growing from $11.09 billion in Q3 to $14.54 billion in Q4, a jump of 31.1%. Year-over-year, inventory grew 154.3% from $5.72 billion in the fourth quarter of 2025.

news.summary_en: Apple executive John Ternus stated during an earnings call that memory costs are expected to keep rising into December, with company inventory surging 154.3% YoY to $14.54 billion due to aggressive stockpiling.

news.title: Trajectory, which is developing AI model post-training tools for nontechnical customers, raised a $45M Series A led by Sequoia at a $300M valuation (Marina Temkin/TechCrunch)
news.title_en: Trajectory, which is developing AI model post-training tools for nontechnical customers, raised a $45M Series A led by Sequoia at a $300M valuation (Marina Temkin/TechCrunch)
news.author: TechCrunch
news.content_snippet:
Whether developed by OpenAI or Anthropic or built on open source alternatives, current AI models share a critical limitation: They don’t learn from their mistakes without further training.

Businesses adapting these models for specialized fields, such as law and finance, typically get around this by fine-tuning general models. However, that often requires hiring internal research teams or relying on expensive consultants, commonly known as forward-deployed engineers (FDEs).

Trajectory, a startu
news.summary_en: Trajectory, founded by former DeepMind and Apple engineers, secured $45 million in Series A funding at a $300 million valuation. The company develops automated post-training tools that allow enterprises to iteratively improve AI models for specialized domains like law and finance without the need for expensive dedicated engineering teams.

【起因与机理】解决通用大模型在专业领域缺乏持续学习能力、依赖人工微调成本高昂的痛点
【关键数据与实测】前DeepMind与苹果工程师创立的Trajectory近日完成4500万美元A轮融资，估值达3亿美元。

[Key Metrics] Trajectory, founded by former DeepMind and Apple engineers, secured $45 million in Series A funding at a $300 million valuation.
[Perspective & Impact] Solves the lack of iterative learning in specialized AI applications.

news.title: Anthropic S-1 claims it may "imminently meet" its RSI threshold and may fail to identify "significant acceleration" in its development until after it's occurred (Julie Bort/TechCrunch)
news.title_en: Anthropic S-1 claims it may "imminently meet" its RSI threshold and may fail to identify "significant acceleration" in its development until after it's occurred (Julie Bort/TechCrunch)
news.author: TechCrunch
news.content_snippet:
While much attention has focused on the updated financials Anthropic revealed in its revised S-1A on Monday, (revenue is soaring, but so are expenses), the AI lab dropped another little bombshell in the fine print.

The filing seems to warn that the company is on the cusp of creating a model capable of recursive self-improvement (RSI).

RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the ca
news.summary_en: Anthropic revealed in its updated S-1 filing that it is nearing the threshold of recursive self-improvement (RSI). The company warns that it may fail to detect sudden, significant accelerations in AI capabilities, acknowledging that using AI to build smarter AI poses uncontrollable safety risks.
news.title_zh: Anthropic预警AI递归自我进化风险
news.summary_zh: Anthropic在上市文件中承认，正逼近递归自我提升（RSI）临界点，恐难在爆发式增长发生前及时预判及控制风险
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】Anthropic在公司最新的S-1A招股书补充文件：承认技术已逼近递归自我提升（RSI）临界点，并预警可能无法及时感知并管控AI爆发式进化带来的安全威胁。
【起因与机理】作为AI开发者，需在商业竞争中保持进度，同时又需履行关于AI失控风险的合规披露义务。
【关键技术规格】Anthropic承认研发逼近RSI临界点。
【观点态度】披露是为了规避后续可能发生的技术失控责任。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Anthropic (Revised S-1A IPO filing): Admitted approaching the RSI threshold and warned of potential inability to manage sudden, unperceived AI capability jumps.
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Balancing the need for rapid R&D progress with the mandatory legal disclosure of catastrophic AI safety risks.
[Key Specification] Anthropic confirms nearing RSI threshold.
[Perspective & Impact] Disclosure serves as a legal hedge against potential runaway tech risks.

news.title: Raising the quality of insights in agentic analytics
news.title_en: Raising the quality of insights in agentic analytics
news.author: MIT Tech Review
news.content_snippet:
In just a few years, generative AI has changed the face of enterprise analytics, notably by making analytics accessible to users across the organization. Agentic AI promises to do even more, by automating entire workflows and taking actions based on agent insights. But there is a problem: The quality of insights that agents currently generate leaves much to be desired.

Fewer than half of agent-generated insights at the organizations surveyed for this report lead to business improvement. And whi
news.summary_en: Recent reports indicate that less than half of agent-generated business insights lead to improvements, as prescriptive AI analytics fall short, exposing enterprises to financial and reputational risks from flawed decisions.

news.title_en: Israeli startup 42AI, which is developing a "behavioral world model" that tries to predict human behavior, emerges from stealth with a $62.5M seed (Ram Iyer/TechCrunch)
news.author: TechCrunch
news.content_snippet:
Here’s a question straight out of sci-fi: What if AI could predict what you were going to do before you decided to, even in a completely new situation?

Israeli startup 42AI says it is developing a “behavioral world model” that can do just that, and it has just come out of stealth with $62.5 million in seed funding. The company is initially running its predictive system at a handful of financial brokerages, where it says the model can help predict how individual traders will respond to volatile
news.summary_en: Israeli startup 42AI emerged from stealth with a $62.5M seed round to develop a 'behavioral world model' predicting human decisions, initially deployed in financial brokerages to gauge trader responses.

news.author: THE DECODER
news.content_snippet:
Anthropic swings back to an operating loss ahead of its blockbuster IPO. According to Bloomberg, the company posted quarterly revenue of nearly $17 billion, twelve times what it brought in a year earlier. But operating costs of $17.5 billion outpaced that revenue, wiping out the profit Anthropic had reported the previous quarter, according to The Information. The net loss came in at $23.3 billion for the quarter, up from $12.1 billion a year ago.

Anthropic pointed to two main drivers behind the
news.summary_en: Anthropic reported a quarterly revenue of nearly $17 billion, a twelvefold year-over-year increase, but faced an operating cost of $17.5 billion, pushing its net loss to $23.3 billion ahead of its planned blockbuster IPO. I want to share some context on a security incident we discovered on October 30.

First, the most important thing: WorkOS's production systems are secure. No customer platform data was accessed. This incident was isolated to internal GTM systems.

The attack involved ARTEX, an autonomous AI agent framework used to carry out offensive security operations. It's a striking example of how quickly the capabilities of attackers are evolving.

We've contained the incident, brought in independent experts to investigate, and are working through the details.

Security is something we take extremely seriously, and I believe in being transparent when things go wrong. We'll continue to share updates as we learn more.

celebrity.full_text_en:
I decompiled probably my favorite game ever: Battlefield 1942 and I put it on the web with multiplayer for you to play here:

👉 https://t.co/6C8H8KtSaU 👈

(It's the free shareware demo)

It was way harder than the other ports like Quake and DOOM I did because they already had lots of open source projects and work behind them

In case of Battlefield 1942 there was literally absolutely nothing to work on top of, nobody had ever ported it and there was no open source engine for it, nor did the makers ever open source it (like id Software did with Quake 3)

I tried it 6 months ago and essentiay gave up but I tried it today again with Opus 5.5 asking "can you try port the BF1942 demo in this folder to web"

So me and Claude Code (well let's be honest mostly Claude Code) did crazy shit today:
- it disassembled the x86 raw machine code to find 57,000 x86 functions
- it translated each x86 function into a C function (mov eax, [esi+0x110] becomes eax = READ32(esi + 0x110), I have no idea what any of this means btw)
- it outputed 100,000 lines of C
- it then compiled that to WebAsswmbly with Emscripten
- there were 300x Windows and Direct3D functions used which we had to rewrite to WebGL 2 and OpenGL to work on the web
- then we had to build our own network stack so it could connect to our multiplayer server via WebSockets

I have no idea how it did any of this but it did it and it seems to work! 😊 

Come play and report any bugs here!
celebrity.full_text_zh:
我反编译了可能是我最喜欢的游戏：《战地 1942》，并将其放在网上，提供多人游戏供您在这里玩：

👉 👈

（这是免费的共享软件演示）

这比我做的《Quake》和《DOOM》等其他移植要困难得多，因为他们已经有很多开源项目和背后的工作

就《战地 1942》而言，实际上完全没有任何东西可以在上面工作，没有人移植它，也没有开源引擎，制作者也没有开源它（就像 id Software 对《雷神之锤 3》所做的那样）

我在 6 个月前尝试过，essentiay 放弃了，但今天我再次尝试，Opus 5.5 询问“你可以尝试将此文件夹中的 BF1942 演示移植到网络吗”

所以我和 Claude Code（老实说，主要是 Claude Code）今天做了一些疯狂的事情：
- 它反汇编了 x86 原始机器代码以找到 57,000 个 x86 函数

celebrity.full_text_en:
$PLTR just delivered one of the most INSANE earnings reports I've seen from a software company, and these numbers are absolutely ridiculous.

The company reported $2.31 BILLION in quarterly revenue, growing 96% year over year, while adjusted operating income reached $1.43 billion. But what really caught my attention was its Rule of 40 score, which just hit an unbelievable 158%. For those unfamiliar, the Rule of 40 combines a company's revenue growth rate with its operating margin to measure how efficiently it is growing. A score of 40% is generally considered healthy for a software company. Palantir just posted 158%, combining roughly 96% revenue growth with a 62% adjusted operating margin.

And what's even crazier is how quickly this has improved. Palantir's score was just 81% in Q4 2024, climbed to 114% by Q3 2025, and has now nearly doubled to 158% in less than two years. The biggest driver continues to be its U.S. commercial business, which grew an incredible 148% year over year to $984 million. U.S. commercial remaining deal value also increased 79% to $6.52 billion, while the company closed 64 deals worth at least $10 million during the quarter.

I think this tells us a lot about where enterprise AI adoption is heading. Companies are moving beyond experimenting with AI and increasingly deploying it across their actual operations. And Palantir is showing what happens when that adoption starts translating into massive revenue growth without requiring expenses to grow anywhere near as quickly. What makes these results even more impressive is that Palantir isn't sacrificing profitability to achieve this growth. Its software business is scaling incredibly efficiently, and that combination of accelerating revenue growth and expanding margins is something very few companies have been able to accomplish at this scale.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
$PLTR 刚刚发布了我所见过的软件公司中最疯狂的收益报告之一，这些数字绝对是荒谬的。

该公司报告季度收入为 23.1 亿美元，同比增长 96%，调整后营业收入达到 14.3 亿美元。但真正引起我注意的是它的 40 规则得分，达到了令人难以置信的 158%。对于那些不熟悉的人来说，40 法则将公司的收入增长率与其营业利润率结合起来，以衡量其增长效率。对于软件公司来说，40% 的分数通常被认为是健康的。 Palantir 刚刚公布了 158% 的业绩，收入增长约 96%，调整后营业利润率为 62%。

更疯狂的是这种情况改善得有多快。 Palantir 的得分在 2024 年第四季度仅为 81%，到 2025 年第三季度攀升至 114%，现在在不到两年的时间里几乎翻了一番，达到 158%。最大的推动力仍然是其美国商业业务，该业务同比增长 148%，达到 9.84 亿美元。美国商业剩余交易价值也增长了 79%，达到 65.2 亿美元，而该公司在本季度完成了 64 笔价值至少 1000 万美元的交易。

我认为这告诉我们很多关于企业人工智能采用的走向。公司正在超越对人工智能的试验，并越来越多地将其部署到实际运营中。 Palantir 正在展示当这种采用开始转化为巨大的收入增长而不要求支出以同样快的速度增长时会发生什么。使这些结果更加令人印象深刻的是 Palantir 并没有牺牲盈利能力来实现这一增长。其软件业务正在以令人难以置信的效率扩展，而加速收入增长和扩大利润的结合是很少有公司能够实现如此规模的。

prompts.code_snippet:
# Cursor & Windsurf Project Rules (.cursorrules)

## 1. Documentation & Code Integrity
- Maintain documentation integrity: Never strip or alter unrelated existing docstrings and comments.
- Preserving context: When modifying a function, preserve surrounding logic and existing edge-case handlers.
- Targeted replacements: Always make minimal surgical edits instead of replacing entire file contents.

## 2. Dependency & API Safety
- Strictly forbid hallucinating npm/pip packages. Only import dependencies already declared in package.json / requirements.txt.
- Verify API signatures before calling external methods. Prefer standard library solutions where feasible.

## 3. Architecture & Type Safety
- Enforce strict TypeScript / Python typing. Avoid `any` types; prefer discriminated unions and explicit return types.
- Defensive coding: Always validate external inputs and handle potential null/undefined values gracefully.

## 4. Testing & Verification Gate
- Every new core feature or bugfix must be accompanied by corresponding unit tests.
- Never declare a task complete without executing lint checks and unit tests in terminal.

prompts.code_snippet:
# 1. 启动项目自动化分析与上下文轻量修剪 (避免上下文爆炸)
claude --compact

# 2. 静默批量执行单元测试与自动修复任务 (CI/CD 友好模式)
claude -p "Run all failing tests under tests/ and apply minimal surgical fixes. Do not touch unrelated files."

# 3. 指定单文件隔离审查模式 (限制仅允许读取特定子目录)
claude --allowed-tools "View,Replace,RunCommand" \
  --dangerously-skip-permissions false \
  -p "Audit security vulnerabilities in auth.py and output remediation report."

# 4. 自动化提交并生成符合 Conventional Commits 规范的 Commit 信息
claude -p "Generate a git commit message following Conventional Commits format for staged changes."

prompts.purpose_zh: 业务数据指标异动排查与趋势归因
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡级别的高级商业数据分析师，精通结构化因果归因与杜邦拆解分析。

针对我提供的 {{业务指标}} 数据，其近期出现 {{异常表现}}，请按以下框架深度剖析：
1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

sample_output.title: 归因分析报告样本：Q3 付费转化率环比下跌 14.2%
sample_output.content:
【核心发现】：GMV 下跌 14.2% 的主要驱动因子并非流量锐减，而是【结算跳失率】从 18% 飙升至 34%。

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；
- 动作3 (预警)：在 Grafana 建立警报公式：`IF(Cart_to_Checkout_Ratio < 0.65, Alert_P0, Normal)`。

"""

First, the most important thing: WorkO
viral_posts.title_en:
I want to share some context on a security incident we discovered on October 30.

First, the most important thing: WorkOS's production systems are secure. No customer platform data was accessed. This incident was isolated to internal GTM systems.

The attack involved ARTEX, an autonomous AI agent framework used to carry out offensive security operations. It's a striking example of how quickly the capabilities of attackers are evolving.

We've contained the incident, brought in independent experts to investigate, and are working through the details.

Security is something we take extremely seriously, and I believe in being transparent when things go wrong. We'll continue to share updates as we learn more.

Full details: https://t.co/6Pt6Nt7kr5

Profitable, yes. Simple, no. Curious what others see in production. https://t.co/HZjgWiUIKv

“With Siri AI, we reall
viral_posts.title_en:
John Ternus answers investor question on where Apple is at with consumer AI agent capabilities:

“With Siri AI, we really have the kind of the Siri that we always wanted. It's primarily request based today, but as we talked about at WWDC, it's built on a modern orchestrated-driven architecture that gives us real room to expand its capabilities over time. As far as agentic capabilities, you know, we think these are promising tools for users. We just want to make sure that users are aware of what they're giving access to. We want to make sure this is done in a way that protects security and privacy. So, you know, we're pushing really hard on that with Siri AI, but we're also really encouraged the fact that Apple devices, we think, are the best places to use all forms of AI.”

viral_posts.full_text_zh:
John Ternus 回答了投资者关于苹果在消费者 AI 代理能力方面处于什么位置的问题：

“有了 Siri AI，我们确实拥有了我们一直想要的 Siri。它现在主要是基于请求的，但正如我们在 WWDC 上谈到的，它建立在现代协调驱动的架构之上，为我们提供了随着时间的推移扩展其功能的真正空间。就代理功能而言，我们认为这些对用户来说是有前途的工具。我们只是想确保用户知道他们正在授予访问权限。我们希望确保以保护安全和隐私的方式完成此操作。所以，你知道，我们正在大力推动 Siri AI 的发展，但我们也非常高兴，因为我们认为 Apple 设备是使用所有形式的 AI 的最佳场所。”

$PLTR just delivered one of the most INSANE earnings reports I've seen from a software company, and these numbers are absolutely ridiculous.

The company reported $2.31 BILLION in quarterly revenue, growing 96% year over year, while adjusted operating income reached $1.43 billion. But what really caught my attention was its Rule of 40 score, which just hit an unbelievable 158%. For those unfamiliar, the Rule of 40 combines a company's revenue growth rate with its operating margin to measure how efficiently it is growing. A score of 40% is generally considered healthy for a software company. Palantir just posted 158%, combining roughly 96% revenue growth with a 62% adjusted operating margin.

And what's even crazier is how quickly this has improved. Palantir's score was just 81% in Q4 2024, climbed to 114% by Q3 2025, and has now nearly doubled to 158% in less than two years. The biggest driver continues to be its U.S. commercial business, which grew an incredible 148% year over year to $984 million. U.S. commercial remaining deal value also increased 79% to $6.52 billion, while the company closed 64 deals worth at least $10 million during the quarter.

I think this tells us a lot about where enterprise AI adoption is heading. Companies are moving beyond experimenting with AI and increasingly deploying it across their actual operations. And Palantir is showing what happens when that adoption starts translating into massive revenue growth without requiring expenses to grow anywhere near as quickly. What makes these results even more impressive is that Palantir isn't sacrificing profitability to achieve this growth. Its software business is scaling incredibly efficiently, and that combination of accelerating revenue growth and expanding margins is something very few companies have been able to accomplish at this scale.

该公司报告季度收入为 23.1 亿美元，同比增长 96%，调整后营业收入达到 14.3 亿美元。但真正引起我注意的是它的 40 规则得分，达到了令人难以置信的 158%。对于那些不熟悉的人来说，40 法则将公司的收入增长率与其营业利润率结合起来，以衡量其增长效率。对于软件公司来说，40% 的分数通常被认为是健康的。 Palantir 刚刚公布了 158% 的业绩，收入增长约 96%，调整后营业利润率为 62%。

更疯狂的是这种情况改善得有多快。 Palantir 的得分在 2024 年第四季度仅为 81%，到 2025 年第三季度攀升至 114%，现在在不到两年的时间里几乎翻了一番，达到 158%。最大的推动力仍然是其美国商业业务，该业务同比增长 148%，达到 9.84 亿美元。美国商业剩余交易价值也增长了 79%，达到 65.2 亿美元，而该公司在本季度完成了 64 笔价值至少 1000 万美元的交易。

我认为这告诉我们很多关于企业人工智能采用的走向。公司正在超越对人工智能的试验，并越来越多地将其部署到实际运营中。 Palantir 正在展示当这种采用开始转化为巨大的收入增长而不要求支出以同样快的速度增长时会发生什么。使这些结果更加令人印象深刻的是 Palantir 并没有牺牲盈利能力来实现这一增长。其软件业务正在以令人难以置信的效率扩展，而加速收入增长和扩大利润的结合是很少有公司能够实现如此规模的。

An LLM that decompiles.

https://t.co/yog4GhEJ72

The same thing for Ghidra.  
An MCP server for reverse engineering tasks inside Ghidra.  
https://t.co/4CYyNsMmel

Agents that reverse engineer anything.  
35 target types: native binaries, APKs, firmware, websites, Electron apps, and more. Every finding is backed by evidence.

现在您可以构建几乎可以对任何东西进行逆向工程的代理：

1.吉德拉
如何读取任何二进制文件。
美国国家安全局的逆向工程框架。几乎每个人都从这里开始。

2.雷达2
相同的技能，但在终端中。
UNIX 风格的逆向工程框架和命令行工具集。

3.LLM4反编译
反编译的法学硕士。
将二进制代码转换为可读的 C 代码。9B v2 模型在其自己的基准测试中达到了 64.9% 的可重复执行性。

4. r2ai
雷达雷2内部的法学硕士。
LLM 驱动的radare2 倒车。这是人工智能开始与您一起读取二进制文件的地方。

5. ida-pro-mcp
让代理驱动该工具。
通过 MCP 将 IDA Pro 连接到语言模型。

6. 逆向工程助手
对于吉德拉来说也是如此。
用于 Ghidra 内部逆向工程任务的 MCP 服务器。

7. 房地产
对任何东西进行逆向工程的代理。
35 种目标类型：本机二进制文件、APK、固件、网站、Electron 应用程序等。每项发现都有证据支持。
